description: Get the text forecast for an NWS forecast zone. Returns named forecast periods (e.g., "Today", "Tonight", "Monday") with detailed narrative text — the human-readable, zone-level forecast written by local forecasters. Completes the alert-to-forecast chain: nws_search_alerts returns each affected zone in "affectedZones" as a code plus a type, and nws_find_stations returns codes in the "forecastZone" column. Only affectedZones entries with type "forecast" work here; entries typed "county" have no text forecast upstream and will not resolve. An entry typed "fire" has its forecast in a segment of the office's Fire Weather Planning Forecast: call nws_get_office_discussion with office set to the alert's "office" field, product_type "FWF", and sections set to the zone code; a fire zone code that is also a public zone code (e.g., "NDZ040") returns that public zone's forecast here, not the fire weather forecast. Marine zones vary by family: coastal zones on an ocean coast, bay, or sound (codes starting AMZ, ANZ, GMZ, PHZ, or PZZ, e.g., "PZZ251") usually serve a text forecast of wind and seas here, while Great Lakes, most Alaska, Guam, American Samoa, and offshore zones (e.g., "GMZ056") have no zone forecast: their text forecast is usually a segment of a marine product (CWF, NSH, GLF, or OFF), and the error names the nws_get_office_discussion call that returns it. Zone codes follow the pattern XXZ### (e.g., "WAZ315" for the City of Seattle). Each forecast is checked against the newest ZFP (CWF for a coastal zone) on file for the zone's office: when that product has expired for the zone, a notice names it and its expiry time, since the first periods may already have elapsed, and when the check cannot answer, a notice says why.

zone_id.description: NWS forecast zone code (e.g., "WAZ315" for the City of Seattle, or a marine zone such as "PZZ251"). Returned as "forecastZone" by nws_get_forecast and nws_find_stations, or as the "code" of an "affectedZones" entry with type "forecast" in nws_search_alerts. Format: two-letter state or marine area code + "Z" + three-digit number.

name: nws_get_zone_forecast

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `zone_not_found`: Zone code is not a valid NWS forecast zone. `zone_forecast_unavailable`: Zone is a valid land forecast zone, but NWS has no text forecast for it. `marine_forecast_unsupported`: Zone is a marine forecast zone NWS serves no zone forecast for; its text forecast is usually a segment of a marine product (CWF, NSH, GLF, or OFF). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Set when updated differs from the value NWS sent (12 hours off, which it names); when NWS sent a time later than the response, returned as sent and not to be trusted; when the newest ZFP (CWF for a coastal zone) on file for the zone's office has expired for this zone, which it names with the product's issuance and expiry times, so the first periods may already have elapsed; or when that expiry could not be checked, with the reason. Several conditions are joined into one notice. With no notice, updated is as NWS sent it and the zone's segment of the newest product is in effect.

periods.description: Forecast periods in chronological order, typically covering 7 days.

items.description: Single forecast period with name and narrative

detailedForecast.description: Full narrative forecast for this period, written by local forecasters (e.g., "Partly cloudy. Highs in the upper 60s. Southwest winds 10 to 15 mph.").

updated.description: When the zone forecast was last updated (ISO 8601 with NWS's timezone offset): the issuance time of the product it comes from. A value NWS sent 12 hours off is corrected, and notice names the value NWS sent; a value later than the response that cannot be corrected is returned as sent, with a notice.

title: Nws Get Zone Forecast
